name: ANGELES//2099 shot plan
rule: Cuts land on bar lines from the cue sheet. Inside a shot, camera accents land on beats; the car's suspension and hover emitters answer the kick, snare, 808 and fx drivers. Both candidates share the 10-bar form (hook 1-2, pocket 3-4, build 5, transition 6, drop 7-8, out 9-10), so this plan fits either; the transition shot has a variant per candidate.
lens: 35 mm-equivalent full frame unless noted; shallow depth of field only in the macro shot

shots.name: Ground-scraping reveal
shots.camera: the opening shows the impossible first: from under the car at road level, the rear-right maglev module and the tiny wire wheel spinning in mid-air over its rippling field, lit by the car's own underglow; it glides out to road level behind the wheel (the 8 cm gap under the tyre silhouetted against the light) by f30, then dollies out to a low rear three-quarter under the sunset
shots.sync: f0 lead whoop: hover ring flares; every kick: body bounce; f60 (bar 2): emitter colour shifts to warm gold with the talkbox shrink

shots.name: Low tracking through the sweeper
shots.camera: lens 24 mm, 2.2 m up and about 4.8 m off, in the road's frame (not the car's), looking down onto the lane lines: the car fills most of the frame so the 12 deg drift and the body lean read on a phone, with little mountain behind it
shots.sync: the car counter-flicks 4 deg (anticipation), then drifts 12 deg into the sweeper on bar 3 with the body leaning late and overshooting; on bar 4 (f180) it drives through the shadow of a blimp we never see (foreshadowing); hydraulic hop on the fx 'hop' frame with a pre-squat and a nose-down landing (crest)

shots.name: Orbit
shots.camera: orbit 150 degrees around the car, rising from 1 m to 3 m, lens 28 mm
shots.sync: orbit speed eases in to bar 6
shots.note: CREST only: under HOVER the spin-up shot S4h owns bars 5-6 (both started at frame 240 before this fix)

shots.name: Into the mouth (CREST)
shots.camera: swallowed: a barrel-roll push into the grille, timed to the vowels. 'ah' (f300) snap push; 'oh/oo' (f308-334) the roll widens to 70 deg and the lens opens 35 -> 30 mm; 'mm' (f334-345) fast push to 0.6 m and the frame seals to black; the roll completes to 360 deg inside the black (f345-356), so the reversed breath shows a level grille
shots.sync: the headlamps are the mouth's eyes: unclipped on 'ah', closing through 'oo', shut on 'mm', a glimmer on the breath; the rim light dims to 12 % for the shot so the candy front does not mirror it; exposure seals to black f336-345

shots.name: Spin-up (HOVER)
shots.camera: static low three-quarter; the car rises 0.6 m on its rings while the rings accelerate from visible pulses to a continuous glow
shots.sync: ring pulse rate follows the spin-up (pulses at f240, fused by ~f310); everything holds still in the eighth of silence (f352-359)

shots.name: Crane reveal of the megacity
shots.camera: on the slam the camera is at bumper height; it cranes up and back over the guardrail, 3 m to 40 m, revealing the basin, downtown megatowers, blimps and the grid
shots.sync: f360 slam: the shot opens level and readable at bumper height behind the car as the body drops onto the modules and violet shock rings race out; kicks keep the car breathing; the crane rises through the multiplane haze to the megacity

shots.name: Hero drift
shots.camera: from the line through the car to the skyline, 34 m off and low, so the megatowers and an airship stand behind the slide; follow-zoom 85-180 mm keeps the car frame-wide; from f570 the camera flies behind the car, down to the road and under the rear bumper into frame 0's pose (car-relative), widening to 24 mm
shots.sync: the hop (f589) lands as the camera slides under the body: the body hides the sky and the sun, the underglow swells and the hover emitters settle to their frame-0 values, so the seam is hidden by occlusion, not a flash

styleframes.name: Hero vehicle
styleframes.purpose: the car backlit against the sunset: silhouette, landau roof, chrome, tiny wheels, hover modules

styleframes.name: Angeles Crest
styleframes.purpose: the road, granite cut, guardrail and the car in the last warm light, depth into the valley

styleframes.name: The megacity

proofFrames.why: one frame per camera move: reveal, tracking, transition, crane, hero
